pretreatment: RF magnetron sputtering system to deposit Au thin film
evidence: ZnS powders and Au-coated Si (100) were, respectively, used as a source material and the substrate for growth of ZnS nanowires. First, an Au thin film 3-nm thick was deposited onto the Si-substrate by using a RF magnetron sputtering system to prepare the Au-coated Si (100) substrate.
